Intel: detect multiple imports and function in JavaScript

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { process } from "@xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack-wasm";
function main() {
  const result = process("import fs from 'fs';\nimport path from 'path';\n\nfunction process(input) {\n    return input.trim();\n}\n", { language: "javascript" });
  console.log(result.language);
  console.log(result.structure);
  console.log(result.structure[0].kind);
  console.log(result.imports);
  console.log(result.metrics.totalLines);
  console.log(result.metrics.errorCount);
}

void main();
```
